fields.name: copernicus:absolute_orbit
fields.desc: The absolute orbit number at the start of acquisition. When the orbit changes during data acquisition (i.e., the acquisition spans multiple orbits), use the absolute orbit number at the start of the acquisition.

fields.name: copernicus:acquisition_station
fields.desc: The acquisition station (ground station) where the satellite data was downlinked. Equivalent to `eop:acquisition_station` in OGC 10-157r4 and OGC 17-003r2.

fields.name: copernicus:acquisition_type
fields.desc: The acquisition type of the product.

fields.name: copernicus:alternate
fields.desc: Alternate asset locations keyed by provider name, each an Asset Object without href.

fields.name: copernicus:alternate_name
fields.desc: A human readable name for the alternate asset.

fields.name: copernicus:anx_datetime
fields.desc: The [Ascending Node](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orbital_node) Crossing (ANX) time, in UTC. It is formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6).

fields.name: copernicus:auth_refs
fields.desc: The names of authentication schemes (keys of copernicus:auth_schemes) that apply to an asset or link.

fields.name: copernicus:auth_schemes
fields.desc: Dictionary of named authentication schemes that guard access to assets or links.

fields.name: copernicus:azimuth
fields.desc: Viewing azimuth angle. The angle measured from the sub-satellite point (point on the ground below the platform) between the scene center and true north. Measured clockwise from north in degrees (0-360).

fields.name: copernicus:bandwidth
fields.desc: The range bandwidth of the SAR instrument, in gigahertz (GHz), representing the full bandwidth used in range compression and image formation.

fields.name: copernicus:bbox
fields.desc: Bounding box of the Item in the asset CRS in 2 or 3 dimensions.

fields.name: copernicus:beam_ids
fields.desc: Composition of the swath of the SAR acquision referencing the beam identifiers.

fields.name: copernicus:bitfields
fields.desc: Classes stored in bit fields in the raster

fields.name: copernicus:bits_per_sample
fields.desc: The actual number of bits used for this band. Normally only present when the number of bits is non-standard for the `datatype`, such as when a 1 bit TIFF is represented as byte.

fields.name: copernicus:cell_methods
fields.desc: null]

fields.name: copernicus:center_frequency
fields.desc: RECOMMENDED. The center frequency of the radar signal transmitted by the instrument, in gigahertz (GHz).

fields.name: copernicus:center_wavelength
fields.desc: The center wavelength of the band, in micrometers (μm).

fields.name: copernicus:centroid
fields.desc: Coordinates representing the centroid of the Item (in lat/long)

fields.name: copernicus:chip_size
fields.desc: Chip size in pixels as `[height, width]`.

fields.name: copernicus:citation
fields.desc: The recommended human-readable reference (citation) to be used by publications citing the data. No specific citation style is suggested, but the citation should contain all information required to find the publication distinctively.

fields.name: copernicus:classes
fields.desc: Classes stored in raster or bands

fields.name: copernicus:cloud_cover
fields.desc: Estimate of cloud cover as a percentage (0-100).

fields.name: copernicus:code
fields.desc: null

fields.name: copernicus:columns
fields.desc: A list of Column Objects describing each column.

fields.name: copernicus:common_name
fields.desc: The name commonly used to refer to the band to make it easier to search for bands across instruments. See the [list of accepted common names](#common-band-names).

fields.name: copernicus:contacts
fields.desc: **REQUIRED.** A list of contacts qualified by their role.

fields.name: copernicus:country
fields.desc: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Two-letter country code for the country that is primarily covered by the data.

fields.name: copernicus:datastrip_id
fields.desc: The identifier of the datastrip, i.e. the part of a datatake that the ground segment processed as one unit. See [Datastrip ID](#datastrip-id) for details.

fields.name: copernicus:datatake_id
fields.desc: Datatake identification. Examples: for S1, datatake_id = 12032; for S2, datatake_id = GS2A_20231215T103431_044292_N05.10

fields.name: copernicus:datetime
fields.desc: Processing date and time of the corresponding data formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6), in UTC.

fields.name: copernicus:description
fields.desc: Corresponds to the [CF `long_name`](https://cfconventions.org/cf-conventions/cf-conventions.html#long-name).

fields.name: copernicus:dimensions
fields.desc: **REQUIRED.** Uniquely named dimensions of the datacube.

fields.name: copernicus:doi
fields.desc: The DOI of the data, e.g. `10.1000/xyz123`. This MUST NOT be a DOIs link. For all DOI names respective DOI links SHOULD be added to the links section (see chapter "Relation types").

fields.name: copernicus:embedding_dimensions
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. Embedding dimensions as an array of sizes, e.g. `[768]` for a single 768-dimensional vector.

fields.name: copernicus:embedding_type
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. Embedding type: `pixel` or `chip`.

fields.name: copernicus:expires
fields.desc: Date and time the corresponding data (see below) expires (is not valid any longer), in UTC.

fields.name: copernicus:expression
fields.desc: An expression or processing chain that describes how the data has been processed. Alternatively, you can also link to a processing chain with the relation type `processing-expression` (see below).

fields.name: copernicus:facility
fields.desc: The name of the facility that produced the data. For example, `Copernicus S1 Core Ground Segment - DPA` for product of Sentinel-1 satellites.

fields.name: copernicus:frequency_band
fields.desc: RECOMMENDED. The common name for the frequency band to make it easier to search for bands across instruments. See section "Common Frequency Band Names" for a list of accepted names.

fields.name: copernicus:full_width_half_max
fields.desc: Full width at half maximum (FWHM). The width of the band, as measured at half the maximum transmission, in micrometers (μm).

fields.name: copernicus:geometry
fields.desc: Defines the footprint of this Item.

fields.name: copernicus:geometry_types
fields.desc: A list of the geometry types present in the dataset.

fields.name: copernicus:grid_code
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. The identifier for the grid element associated with the Item.

fields.name: copernicus:grid_id
fields.desc: Grid system the chips are aligned to. See [Grid IDs](#grid-ids).

fields.name: copernicus:histogram
fields.desc: Histogram distribution information of the pixels values in the band.

fields.name: copernicus:incidence_angle
fields.desc: The incidence angle is the angle between the vertical (normal) to the intercepting surface and the line of sight back to the satellite at the scene center. Measured in degrees (0-90).

fields.name: copernicus:instrument_configuration_id
fields.desc: The instrument configuration ID is specific to S1 SAR instrument and refers to the onboard configuration. Each version of it has a specific identifier called "Instrument Configuration ID" (ICID) corresponding to a specific number. For more information, cf. ["What is the instrument configuration ID (ICID) ?"](https://sar-mpc.eu/about/faq/)

fields.name: copernicus:instrument_mode
fields.desc: Mode of the altimetry instrument used to collect the data.

fields.name: copernicus:instrument_type
fields.desc: Type of altimetry instrument used to collect the data.

fields.name: copernicus:level
fields.desc: The name commonly used to refer to the processing level to make it easier to search for product level across collections or items. The short name must be used (only `L`, not `Level`). See the [list of suggested processing levels](#suggested-processing-levels).

fields.name: copernicus:lineage
fields.desc: Lineage Information provided as free text information about the how observations were processed or models that were used to create the resource being described [NASA ISO](https://wiki.earthdata.nasa.gov/display/NASAISO/Lineage+Information). For example, `GRD Post Processing` for "GRD" product of Sentinel-1 satellites. [CommonMark 0.29](https://commonmark.org/) syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

fields.name: copernicus:looks_azimuth
fields.desc: Number of azimuth looks, which is the number of groups of signal samples (looks) parallel to the flight path.

fields.name: copernicus:looks_equivalent_number
fields.desc: The equivalent number of looks (ENL).

fields.name: copernicus:looks_range
fields.desc: Number of range looks, which is the number of groups of signal samples (looks) perpendicular to the flight path.

fields.name: copernicus:mmu
fields.desc: Minimum Mapping Unit - the smallest polygon area represented.

fields.name: copernicus:mmw
fields.desc: Minimal Mapping Width - the smallest real-world width represented as polygon.

fields.name: copernicus:moon_azimuth
fields.desc: Moon azimuth angle. From the scene center point on the ground, this is the angle between truth north and the moon. Measured clockwise in degrees (0-360).

fields.name: copernicus:moon_elevation
fields.desc: Moon elevation angle. The angle from the tangent of the scene center point to the moon. Measured from the horizon in degrees (`0`-`90`).

fields.name: copernicus:name
fields.desc: A human-readable name of the relevant region.

fields.name: copernicus:nominal_track
fields.desc: An array of coordinates used to define the nominal track on the earths surface. This value is recommended ONLY if the item geometry is not representative of the acquisition track.

fields.name: copernicus:observation_direction
fields.desc: Antenna pointing direction relative to the flight trajectory of the satellite, either `left` or `right`.

fields.name: copernicus:off_nadir
fields.desc: The angle from the sensor between nadir (straight down) and the scene center. Measured in degrees (0-90).

fields.name: copernicus:offset
fields.desc: Number to be added to the pixel value (after scaling) to transform into the value (i.e. translate digital number to reflectance).

fields.name: copernicus:open_kwargs
fields.desc: Keyword arguments to provide to the xarray opener

fields.name: copernicus:orbit_cycle
fields.desc: The number of repeat cycle done by the satellite at the time of the acquisition. [Repeat cycle](https://ltb.itc.utwente.nl/page/498/concept/81577) is the time between two successive identical orbits.

fields.name: copernicus:orbit_state
fields.desc: The state of the orbit. Either `ascending` or `descending` for polar orbiting satellites, `geostationary` for geosynchronous satellites, or `crossing` when the acquisition spans a polar crossing.

fields.name: copernicus:orbit_state_vectors
fields.desc: The state vectors of the satellite at the time of acquisition.

fields.name: copernicus:order_date
fields.desc: Indicates the order submission time, in UTC and formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6).

fields.name: copernicus:order_expiration_date
fields.desc: **DEPRECATED.** Indicates the validity time of the order, in UTC and formatted according to [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). Use [`expires` from the timestamps extension](https://github.com/stac-extensions/timestamps/) instead.

fields.name: copernicus:order_id
fields.desc: Identifier of the order.

fields.name: copernicus:order_status
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. Describe the status of the ordering. One of the value listed [here](#orderstatus)

fields.name: copernicus:origin_datetime
fields.desc: Date time of the input data considered to create the item. Example: for PRIP, time of the availability of all CADU data on the CADIP/XBIP

fields.name: copernicus:original_data_type
fields.desc: Data type before quantization. Uses the same [data type values](https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/master/commons/common-metadata.md#data-types) as `data_type`.

fields.name: copernicus:pixel_spacing_azimuth
fields.desc: The azimuth pixel spacing, which is the distance between adjacent pixels parallel to the flight path, in meters (m). Strongly RECOMMENDED to be specified for products of type `GRD`.

fields.name: copernicus:pixel_spacing_range
fields.desc: The range pixel spacing, which is the distance between adjacent pixels perpendicular to the flight path, in meters (m). Strongly RECOMMENDED to be specified for products of type `GRD`.

fields.name: copernicus:platform_international_designator
fields.desc: The International Designator, also known as COSPAR ID, and NSSDCA ID

fields.name: copernicus:pmtiles_layers
fields.desc: The PMTiles layers to display.

fields.name: copernicus:polarizations
fields.desc: RECOMMENDED. Any combination of polarizations.

fields.name: copernicus:primary_datetime
fields.desc: The primary date/time column name.

fields.name: copernicus:primary_geometry
fields.desc: The primary geometry column name.

fields.name: copernicus:product_status
fields.desc: The lifecycle/status of the product.

fields.name: copernicus:product_type
fields.desc: The product type.

fields.name: copernicus:projjson
fields.desc: null

fields.name: copernicus:publications
fields.desc: List of relevant publications referencing and describing the data.

fields.name: copernicus:published
fields.desc: Date and time the corresponding data (see below) was published the first time, in UTC.

fields.name: copernicus:quality_status
fields.desc: The quality status of the product: `nominal` or `degraded`.

fields.name: copernicus:quantization_method
fields.desc: Quantization method (e.g. `linear`).

fields.name: copernicus:reference_scale
fields.desc: Representative fraction denominator (e.g., 50000 for 1:50,000).

fields.name: copernicus:relative_burst
fields.desc: Identification number that uniquely identifies a burst cycle within each repeat cycle.

fields.name: copernicus:relative_orbit
fields.desc: The relative orbit number at the start of acquisition. When the orbit changes during data acquisition (i.e., the acquisition spans multiple orbits), use the relative orbit number at the start of the acquisition.

fields.name: copernicus:renders
fields.desc: Dictionary of rendering instructions that can be viewed, keyed by a unique render name.

fields.name: copernicus:resolution_azimuth
fields.desc: The azimuth resolution, which is the maximum ability to distinguish two adjacent targets parallel to the flight path, in meters (m).

fields.name: copernicus:resolution_range
fields.desc: The range resolution, which is the maximum ability to distinguish two adjacent targets perpendicular to the flight path, in meters (m).

fields.name: copernicus:row_count
fields.desc: The number of rows in the dataset.

fields.name: copernicus:sampling
fields.desc: One of `area` or `point`. Indicates whether a pixel value should be assumed to represent a sampling over the region of the pixel or a point sample at the center of the pixel.

fields.name: copernicus:sampling_rate
fields.desc: Sampling rate of the altimetry instrument in Hz.

fields.name: copernicus:scale
fields.desc: Multiplicator factor of the pixel value to transform into the value (i.e. translate digital number to reflectance).

fields.name: copernicus:season
fields.desc: The VPP season number. One of `S1` or `S2`. See below for details.

fields.name: copernicus:servers
fields.desc: The servers to substitute for the {s} variable in the link href.

fields.name: copernicus:shape
fields.desc: Number of pixels in Y and X directions for the default grid

fields.name: copernicus:snow_cover
fields.desc: Estimate of snow and ice cover as a percentage (0-100).

fields.name: copernicus:software
fields.desc: A dictionary with name/version for key/value describing one or more applications or libraries that were involved during the production of the data for provenance purposes.

fields.name: copernicus:solar_illumination
fields.desc: The solar illumination of the band, as measured at half the maximum transmission, in W/m2/micrometers.

fields.name: copernicus:spatial_resolution
fields.desc: Average spatial resolution (in meters) of the pixels in the band.

fields.name: copernicus:standard_name
fields.desc: Corresponds to the [CF Standard Name](https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-standard-names/current/build/cf-standard-name-table.html).

fields.name: copernicus:stats_catalogs
fields.desc: A lookup of statistics for all child catalogs.

fields.name: copernicus:stats_collections
fields.desc: A lookup of statistics for all child collections.

fields.name: copernicus:stats_items
fields.desc: A lookup of statistics for all child items.

fields.name: copernicus:storage_options
fields.desc: **DEPRECATED** Additional keywords for opening the dataset.

fields.name: copernicus:storage_refs
fields.desc: A property that specifies which schemes in copernicus:storage_schemes may be used to access an Asset or Link. Each value must be one of the keys defined in copernicus:storage_schemes.

fields.name: copernicus:storage_schemes
fields.desc: A property that contains all of the storage schemes used by Assets and Links in the STAC Item, Catalog or Collection.

fields.name: copernicus:stride
fields.desc: Step between the origins of neighboring chips in pixels as `[row_stride, col_stride]`. When `stride < chip_size`, chips overlap.

fields.name: copernicus:sub_parameter
fields.desc: The VPP sub-parameter acronym. See below for the list of allowed values.

fields.name: copernicus:subdivision
fields.desc: ISO 3166-2 codes for identifying the principal subdivisions (e.g., provinces or states) of a country that is primarily covered by the data. Only provide the second part of the ISO 3166-2 code to reduce redundancy.

fields.name: copernicus:sun_azimuth
fields.desc: Sun azimuth angle. From the scene center point on the ground, this is the angle between truth north and the sun. Measured clockwise in degrees (0-360).

fields.name: copernicus:sun_elevation
fields.desc: Sun elevation angle. The angle from the tangent of the scene center point to the sun. Measured from the horizon in degrees (`-90`-`90`). Negative values indicate the sun is below the horizon, e.g. sun elevation of -10° means the data was captured during [nautical twilight](https://www.timeanddate.com/astronomy/different-types-twilight.html).

fields.name: copernicus:tables
fields.desc: **DEPRECATED** A list of Table Objects (see below).

fields.name: copernicus:temporal_period
fields.desc: Temporal compositing period as an [ISO 8601 duration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Durations) (e.g. `P1Y`, `P3M`).

fields.name: copernicus:themes
fields.desc: **REQUIRED.** A knowledge organization system used to classify the STAC entity. Each element is a concept and their respective knowledge organization system / controlled vocabulary.

fields.name: copernicus:timeliness
fields.desc: The average expected timeliness of the product as an [ISO 8601 Duration](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Durations).

fields.name: copernicus:timeliness_category
fields.desc: A proprietary category identifier for the timeliness of the product.

fields.name: copernicus:transform
fields.desc: The affine transformation coefficients for the default grid

fields.name: copernicus:unit
fields.desc: Corresponds to the [CF `units`](https://cfconventions.org/cf-conventions/cf-conventions.html#units).

fields.name: copernicus:unpublished
fields.desc: Date and time the corresponding data (see below) was unpublished, in UTC.

fields.name: copernicus:variables
fields.desc: Uniquely named variables of the datacube.

fields.name: copernicus:version
fields.desc: The version of the primary processing software or processing chain that produced the data. For example, this could be the processing baseline for the Sentinel missions.

fields.name: copernicus:wkt2
fields.desc: null

fields.name: copernicus:wms_dimensions
fields.desc: WMS dimensions and their values.

fields.name: copernicus:wms_layers
fields.desc: The WMS layers to display.

fields.name: copernicus:wms_styles
fields.desc: The WMS styles to apply.

fields.name: copernicus:wms_transparent
fields.desc: Whether the WMS map background is transparent.

fields.name: copernicus:wmts_dimensions
fields.desc: WMTS dimensions and their values.

fields.name: copernicus:wmts_encoding
fields.desc: The encoding to use for WMTS requests: `rest` or `kvp`.

fields.name: copernicus:wmts_layer
fields.desc: The WMTS layer identifier.

fields.name: copernicus:renders/asset_as_band
fields.desc: Treat assets in `expression` as single bands. Required when expression uses multiple assets

fields.name: copernicus:renders/assets
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. Array of asset keys [referencing the assets](#assets-reference) that are used to make the rendering

fields.name: copernicus:renders/bidx
fields.desc: Band(s) to select from each referenced asset, one entry per position in `assets` (an asset needing no sub-selection uses an empty array `[]`). Each selector is either a 1-based band index (matching the GDAL/rio-tiler/titiler convention) or a band name matching the `name` of a Band Object declared on that asset (via `eo:bands`, `raster:bands`, or the STAC [common `bands`](https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/v1.1.0/commons/common-metadata.md#bands) construct) — useful since `name` is not required on a Band Object. See [Band references](#band-references).

fields.name: copernicus:renders/color_formula
fields.desc: [Color formula](https://developmentseed.org/titiler/user_guide/rendering/#color-formula) that must be applied for a raster band

fields.name: copernicus:renders/colormap
fields.desc: [Color map JSON definition](https://developmentseed.org/titiler/user_guide/rendering/#custom-colormaps) that must be applied for a raster band

fields.name: copernicus:renders/colormap_name
fields.desc: Color map identifier that must be applied for a raster band

fields.name: copernicus:renders/expression
fields.desc: Band arithmetic formula to apply to the referenced assets. The format is defined by the rendering application, e.g. a [TiTiler](https://developmentseed.org/titiler/) band math string or a [MapLibre](https://maplibre.org/maplibre-style-spec/expressions/) style expression array.

fields.name: copernicus:renders/minmax_zoom
fields.desc: Zoom levels range applicable for the visualization

fields.name: copernicus:renders/nodata
fields.desc: Nodata value to use for this render, overriding any nodata value already defined on the referenced assets (e.g. via the [raster](https://github.com/stac-extensions/raster) extension). If not set, implementations SHOULD fall back to the asset's own nodata value.

fields.name: copernicus:renders/resampling
fields.desc: Resampling algorithm to apply to the referenced assets. See [GDAL resampling algorithm](https://gdal.org/programs/gdalwarp.html#cmdoption-gdalwarp-r) for some examples.

fields.name: copernicus:renders/rescale
fields.desc: 2 dimensions array of delimited Min,Max range per band. If not provided, the data will not be rescaled.

fields.name: copernicus:renders/title
fields.desc: Optional title of the rendering

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/addresses
fields.desc: Physical location at which contact can be made.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/contactInstructions
fields.desc: Supplemental instructions on how or when to contact the responsible party.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/description
fields.desc: Detailed multi-line description to fully explain the STAC entity. [CommonMark 0.29](https://commonmark.org/) syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/emails
fields.desc: Email address at which contact can be made.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/identifier
fields.desc: A value uniquely identifying a contact.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/links
fields.desc: Links related to the contact. The link relation should be `about` and the media type must indicate the content type of the link (e.g. `text/html` for a company's web page versus `text/vcard` for a virtual contact file).

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/logo
fields.desc: Graphic identifying a contact. The link relation must be `icon` and the media type must be an image media type.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/name
fields.desc: **REQUIRED if `organization` is missing**. The name of the responsible person.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/organization
fields.desc: **REQUIRED if `name` is missing**. Organization/affiliation of the contact.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/phones
fields.desc: Telephone numbers at which contact can be made.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/position
fields.desc: The name of the role or position of the responsible person taken from the organization's formal organizational hierarchy or chart.

fields.name: copernicus:contacts/roles
fields.desc: The set of named duties, job functions and/or permissions associated with this contact. See [Roles](#roles) for recommended values.

fields.name: copernicus:themes/concepts
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. One or more entity/concept identifers from this knowledge system.

fields.name: copernicus:themes/scheme
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. An identifier for the knowledge organization system used. It is recommended that the identifier is a resolvable URI.

fields.name: copernicus:storage_schemes/platform
fields.desc: **REQUIRED.** The cloud provider where data is stored as URI or URI template to the API.

fields.name: copernicus:storage_schemes/region
fields.desc: The region where the data is stored. Relevant to speed of access and inter region egress costs (as defined by PaaS provider).

fields.name: copernicus:storage_schemes/requester_pays
fields.desc: Is the data "requester pays" (`true`) or is it "data manager/cloud provider pays" (`false`). Defaults to `false`.

fields.name: copernicus:storage_schemes/type
fields.desc: **REQUIRED.** Type identifier for the platform, see below.

fields.name: copernicus:histogram/buckets
fields.desc: Array of integer indicating the number of pixels included in the bucket.

fields.name: copernicus:histogram/count
fields.desc: number of buckets of the distribution.

fields.name: copernicus:histogram/max
fields.desc: minimum value of the distribution. Also the mean value of the last bucket.

fields.name: copernicus:histogram/min
fields.desc: minimum value of the distribution. Also the mean value of the first bucket.

fields.name: copernicus:expression/expression
fields.desc: Any data type, depending on the format chosen.

fields.name: copernicus:expression/format
fields.desc: **REQUIRED** The type of the expression that is specified in the `expression` property.

fields.name: copernicus:publications/citation
fields.desc: Citation of a publication referencing the data.

fields.name: copernicus:publications/doi
fields.desc: The DOI of a publication referencing the data. This MUST NOT be a DOIs link.

fields.name: copernicus:columns/description
fields.desc: Detailed multi-line description to explain the dimension. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

fields.name: copernicus:columns/name
fields.desc: **REQUIRED**. The column name.

fields.name: copernicus:columns/type
fields.desc: Native data type of the column. If using a file format with a type system (like Parquet), we recommend you use those types.
